title: HydroBrick & Maxx Whip Adapter
description:
The Whip Adapter is made from high quality medical grade silicone tubing which connects 2 glass joint whip adapters. One of which being an 18mm female glass joint whip adapter and the other is your choice of either an 18mm female, 18mm male, 14mm female or a 14mm male glass joint whip adapter. This joint type and size has to connect to the glass joint on the rig you intend it for.
Included
1 x 40cm Medical Grade Silicone Hose
1 x 18mm Female Glass Joint Whip Adapter
1 x Glass Joint Whip Adapter of your choice
